record.one_liner: AI-driven web scraping platform with a REST scraper API, API-token auth and an official MCP server.
record.auth_notes: Static API token from the MrScraper dashboard, sent in the x-api-token header; Marketplace endpoints accept an RFC 6750 Bearer token. No OAuth for the public API (the hosted MCP server uses OAuth 2.1, which is MCP-side, not the public API). critic: confirmed.
record.access_notes: Free plan with no credit card; tokens reset monthly. Docs conflict on the allowance: billing page table lists 1,000 API tokens for Scraper Free, while the Free Plan Limitations section says 100 tokens per month. critic: confirmed self_serve_free, working free-plan credentials with no card.
record.api_notes: REST, JSON in and out, with pagination and analytics/subscription endpoints. Full endpoint coverage was not enumerated in this pass.
record.blocker_notes: critic: confirmed; self-serve free credentials and a documented public API, no review gate found.

evidence.quote: Include your API token in the x-api-token HTTP header on every request:
The Free plan includes 100 tokens per month with no credit card required.
Built on REST principles, our API offers predictable resource-oriented URLs
An MCP server exposing the seven MrScraper services through hosted HTTP or local stdio.
Every request must include a valid API token in the HTTP request headers.
